pages.title: Kandar's Open Conjure
pages.text: $(bold)Purpose:$() Summon an $(#AA00AA)Unbound Afrit$()$(br2)$(bold)Kandars Open Conjure$() is a simplified version of $(#FF55FF)Abras Conjure$(), allowing to summon $(#AA00AA)Afrit$() without red chalk.$(br) Due to the much reduced power of the pentacle, it cannot be used to control $(#AA00AA)Afrit$(),$()

pages.title: Kandar's Open Conjure
pages.text: $(br) and it thus can only be used to fight and kill $(#AA00AA)Afrit$().$(br)
